task: Repair HomeCheck performance and security alerts in OpenHarmony ArkTS projects
dataset: Ten projects selected from the frozen 35-project candidate set using a seeded 2 x 2 LOC-by-alert-density design
split: One fixed ten-project evaluation set; no tuning split
evaluation_path: Initial HomeCheck scan, at most five agent-visible post-edit scans, then one evaluator-only final HomeCheck scan
known_deviations: The comparator is a runnable contemporary coding agent rather than an ArkTS port of InferFix, DeepCode AI Fix, or PredicateFix.
Recovered current upstream commits may differ from the deleted server copies used for the original 8,664-alert experiment; both new conditions nevertheless use identical pinned inputs.
API cost remains null unless it can be traced to an explicit provider price or billing record.
